'''Algwyn''' was the last male Emperor of [[Seanchan]].

==History==
He was Emperor a long time ago. Tuon thinks it is "almost a thousand years ago", while Suroth thinks "nine hundred years".{{ref/book|9|14}}{{ref/book|11|e}} [[The Wheel of Time Companion]] differs in saying "over a thousand years".{{ref|{{twotc}}, Algwyn}}

Many thought Algwyn was mad because he let his ''[[soe'feia]]'' slap him in public.{{ref/book|9|14}}
